BiblicalUsage: Zina is named as a son of Shimei the Gershonite Levite, one of the four sons listed in David's census of the Levites. The very next verse calls the same man Zizah, so Zina and Zizah are one man under two spellings of his name. His work was the Levites' work: serving in the house of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two spellings are a small reminder that Scripture's people are real people, recorded by different hands — and that one man's name can reach us twice without making him two men.
